items.title: Live: Herzog welcomed at Government House as peaceful protesters gather outside Parliament
items.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog is welcomed to Canberra as protesters gather on the lawns outside Parliament House. Follow live.

items.title: Liberals plot mass resignations, paving way for leadership challenge
items.description: Liberals are bracing for a wave of frontbench resignations as soon as Wednesday to pave the way for Angus Taylor to mount a leadership challenge against Sussan Ley.

items.title: Here's what's really causing millions of mortgage borrowers grief
items.description: It may sound boring, but "capacity constraints" are to blame for your higher mortgage repayments.

items.title: Victorian government defends action on construction sector amid CFMEU allegations
items.description: The Victorian government is defending its handling of corruption in the state's construction sector amid accusations in a major corruption report that it was "cowed" by the CFMEU.

items.title: Major change could be coming to supermarket shelves
items.description: The nation's food ministers will this week take a crucial step towards mandating the Health Star Rating scheme on packaged food products.

items.title: As Epstein spotlight shifts to UK, Trump could have 3 million reasons to worry
items.description: Donald Trump's enemies made no secret of their hopes the documents would contain something explosive enough to bring the president down, but right now the Epstein spotlight is on Britain's politicians and palaces.

items.title: FBI releases doorbell camera photos from Nancy Guthrie's home
items.description: FBI director Kash Patel has posted the images on social media, saying they had been recovered after days of work by investigators.

items.title: Woman 'frustrated and mystified' after Uber guide dog case settles
items.description: Uber quietly agrees to an external review of its Australian operations after settling a Federal Court case brought by a woman refused more than 30 rides while travelling with a guide dog.

items.title: 'How dare you': The 29-year career behind this former cop's viral DV lecture
items.description: Years on the front line of domestic violence surfaced in a frustration-filled moment on national television for Vincent Hurley. He explains what motivates him to keep fighting for change.

items.title: Live: CSL shares fall sharply after CEO resigns, CBA profits up
items.description: The Australian share market is higher on the first "big day" of reporting season with good news for Commonwealth Bank, but CSL shares are down sharply a day after the biotech giant dumped its chief executive, Paul McKenzie. Follow live.

items.title: A month on from Iran's protests, reports emerge of security forces 'refusing orders'
items.description: As talks between Washington and Tehran over a nuclear deal continue, fractures within the regime are starting to emerge.

items.title: Quick hits: A cheating admission and a US star's tribute both bring tears
items.description: A Norwegian's first-ever medal is overshadowed by a stunning admission to reporters as Maxim Naumov pays tribute to his parents in the most beautiful way. Here are the quick hits from the Winter Olympics.

items.title: Landmark High Court ruling finds Catholic Church liable for harm
items.description: A man who suffered sexual abuse at the hands of a priest in the 1960s has won his High Court battle over liability, but had his compensation nearly halved.

items.title: Farmers lay blame for devastating fires at WA government's feet
items.description: Farmers and volunteer firefighters say decades of neglect by WA's Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions is at the heart of fires that ripped through more than 200,000 hectares of state-managed land.

items.title: Western quoll joey born in the wild after conservation program success
items.description: Once thought to be extinct in NSW, the small, spotted, and highly photogenic western quoll is making a hard-fought comeback to the wild.

items.title: Socceroo scores hat-trick on starting debut in English Championship
items.description: Mohamed Toure moved to England recently on a $5 million deal and it is already looking like a great decision for the 21-year-old forward.

items.title: Travel quiz: Which Spanish city hosts a tomato-throwing festival?
items.description: Which European country has no McDonalds? And where's Australia's most western point?

items.title: Sharks had never been seen this far south. Then one swam into view
items.description: A slow-moving sleeper shark captured on camera deep below the ocean surface near the South Shetland Islands is the first shark species to ever be found in Antarctic waters.

items.title: Girl, 5, killed in ATV rollover on Queensland property
items.description: A young girl has died and a boy has been injured after an ATV being driven by a child rolled rolled on a rural property near Chinchilla on Tuesday evening.

items.title: ASIO ordered independent review into Bondi terror case, stands by 2019 assessment
items.description: The nation's top spy has welcomed a royal commission into the Bondi terror attack, vowing to "own any mistakes" uncovered by the probe as his agency comes under pressure over whether the tragedy could have been prevented.

items.title: Images of alleged tobacco wars kingpin released as police vow to crush syndicate
items.description: Hamad was deported from Australia in 2023 and has been a key person of interest relating to firebombings at Victorian tobacco shops and businesses.

items.title: Prospector was fighting hidden cancer battle before outback disappearance
items.description: An inquest into Barry Podmore's disappearance in WA's remote Midwest hears the 73-year-old faced significant health challenges.

items.title: SA Liberals face wipeout not seen since state bank election
items.description: Labor faced a humiliating election loss following the state bank collapse in the early 90s. Now, recent polling shows a collapse of another kind could be brewing for the Liberal Party with One Nation hot on its heels.

items.title: Celine Cremer's car key, more bones found in riverbed search
items.description: Tasmania Police say a car key found in the Arthur River has been "formally verified" as belonging to missing backpacker Celine Cremer.

items.title: 'My features were a puzzle': Surgeon Kelvin Kong on growing up Chinese and Indigenous
items.description: Australia's first identified First Nations surgeon, Dr Kelvin Kong spoke about his Malaysian Chinese heritage during the annual Wang Gungwu lecture at Parliament House.
